task.title: Reconcile card_tags with relocating delete (tags stay on hidden collections)
task.description: Filed from P6-188 (2026-08-09). When delete_collection relocates holdings out (real ledger moves), card-tagging's 'last holding and desire leave' cleanup rule is deliberately NOT applied — card_tags stay attached to the hidden collection, which is what makes a step-5 restore intact. But this diverges from what the card-tagging spec prescribes for ordinary moves out of a collection. Decide and document the reconciliation: either the divergence is the intended rule for delete (document it in specs/card-tagging.md), or tags need migration to the destination alongside the holdings. Interacts with P6-190 (restore). Specs: specs/collection-deletion.md, card-tagging spec.
